dc_title_s: Bike Routes, City of Oshkosh, WI 2026
dc_description_s: This data represents bike routes for the City of Oshkosh in 2026.[Overview: This data provides a spatial inventory of constructed bike routes. It supports viewing and sharing linear bicycle infrastructure features along streets and trails, with attributes that describe route characteristics, construction details, surface and material information, condition, and route naming. Bike-Routes-Constructed: Line features representing built bike routes and related bicycle corridors. The layer includes route identification and descriptive attributes such as street name, route segment limits, route type, year constructed, construction material, surface, condition, trail name, and route length. Geographic Coverage: The service covers a localized area with an extent centered on the city's roadway and trail network. Use Cases: Planning and managing bicycle transportation infrastructure Supporting trail and route inventory maintenance Displaying bike-accessible corridors in web maps and applications Reference for recreation and active transportation analysis]
uw_supplemental_s: This is an archived copy of the data held at UW-Madison.
